title: The time Bigard nearly beat Duke
summary: Duke interfered in Bigard's love life; Bigard grabbed him by the neck before Cootie caught his arm, and he thinks Tizol once wanted to cut Duke.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: He always had to have a lot of intrigue around him, --
Yeah.
-- even if he had to create it himself on purpose, just to keep things stirred up.
He was something else. I wanted to beat him one time.
You what?
I almost beat him.
What happened?
I had him by the neck and the head and I was getting ready to smash him.
What had happened?
Huh?
What were you mad about?
He interfered in my love life. I told him, 'Cut it out.'
He always did that with the members of the band, didn't he? He always tried to --
Yeah.
-- mind everybody's business.

Show somebody how to do, what to do, and what not to. You see, I'm a man. I'm like you. I don't tell you what to do. And one word led to another and I just grabbed him and I was going to whack him, and one of the guys -- I
think it was Cootie -- grabbed my arm and I just threw him up in the corner or something.
Did anybody ever get so mad that they hit him or beat him that you know of?

No, no, not that I know of. I tell you, see, it doesn't pay to hit a man like that because he's a big shot and you're a little, like the little frog in the pond, you know. And so I said, "Oh, forget it." I think Tizol wanted to cut him once, I think. I don't know. He was something else. But all in all, he was great. I liked Duke till he started stealing tunes. You know, he was all right.
I know you told me --
